overridableConfigKeys.label: Grid Height

overridableConfigKeys.label: Grid Width
overridableConfigKeys.description: Grid column count clamping move + wander bounds

overridableConfigKeys.label: Move Budget
overridableConfigKeys.description: Moves the hero may spend before the round is lost if objectives remain

overridableConfigKeys.label: Running
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true, MOVE/WANDER intents are applied; toggle to freeze the board

overridableConfigKeys.label: Tiles
overridableConfigKeys.description: Grid tiles used for passability checks (auto-generated all-passable when empty)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Initial Units
overridableConfigKeys.description: Seed roster: the player hero plus any neutral NPCs

overridableConfigKeys.label: Features
overridableConfigKeys.description: Board features — collectible targets (matched by targetType) plus decorations

overridableConfigKeys.label: Points Per Target
overridableConfigKeys.description: Score awarded per objective reached

overridableConfigKeys.label: Reach Radius
overridableConfigKeys.description: Manhattan distance at which a target counts as reached: 0 = step onto the tile (collect), 1 = adjacent (deliver)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Remove On Reach
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true the target model is removed once reached (collect); when false it is flagged done and stays (visit/deliver)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Running
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true, hero steps onto targets are scored; toggle to freeze

overridableConfigKeys.label: Start Score
overridableConfigKeys.description: Score set on INIT

overridableConfigKeys.label: Target Type
overridableConfigKeys.description: Feature type counted as a collectible objective

overridableConfigKeys.label: Decay Rate
overridableConfigKeys.description: Ttl units removed from every fx entry each tick; higher fades particles faster.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Initial Fx
overridableConfigKeys.description: Seed particles rendered before the first BURST; usually empty.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Running
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true the decay tick runs; toggle to freeze effects.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Running
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true, PROGRESS signals resolve win/lose; toggle to freeze

events.name: MOVE
events.description: Hero move intent applied by the hero-nav authority

events.name: WANDER
events.description: Advances neutral NPCs one random step via the hero-nav authority

events.name: RESTART
events.description: Resets every mechanic (units/budget, objectives, result) for a new round
